blocks.text: Horror movies may be part of John Arcilla’s decorated filmography, but he said fictional monsters are not what frighten him the most, but corrupt politicians and people who kill others. Arcilla spoke about his fears during the mini press conference for Regal Entertainment’s Metro Manila Film Festival (MMFF) 2026 entry “Haunted Carnival” on Wednesday, Nov. 11, in Quezon City. “Hindi ako fan ng scary movie. But I can do that. Kasi mas gusto kong ako yung gumagawa ng nakakatakot na bagay,” he said. “Pag nanonood ako ng scary movies, sinasabi ko lagi, ’Ah, oo, ginagawa ko ‘yan eh.’ … ’Ah, okay, […]...
